name: Tallyman Brusk
title: Clean Books
examine: Ink on his fingers and a fence's patience in his eyes. The books balance every night, which is more than the bank can say about its conscience.
lines: Provenance is a story, and I pay by weight, not by story.
The docket pays honest coin for honest work. The counter pays honest coin for the other kind.
Every ledger in the Dawnlands lies except mine. Mine just changes some names.
